title: Crumb Session (crumb.session v1)
description: A portable, logged-in browser session for exactly one account. Contains secret values: implementations MUST encrypt it at rest and MUST NOT print it to an agent. `state` is a superset of Playwright's storageState, so any tool that reads storageState can consume it after unknown fields are dropped.

label.description: Human-friendly name, e.g. "Work GitHub (viraat@exla.ai)". Never used for lookup.

home.description: Where an agent should land after the session is opened.

scope.description: Registrable domains this account is allowed to act on (e.g. ["github.com", "githubusercontent.com"]). Cookies outside the scope MAY be dropped on import.

accountName.description: Account key within a site, e.g. "work".

mode.description: state: the session is fully described by `state` and can be injected into any fresh browser context (portable, many concurrent copies). profile: the session also lives in a persistent browser profile directory owned by the implementation (needed for device-bound sessions such as Google DBSC; one browser at a time).

domain.description: Leading dot (".github.com") means the cookie also applies to subdomains; no dot means host-only.

expires.description: Unix time in seconds; -1 for a session cookie.

partitionKey.description: CHIPS partition (top-level site) for partitioned cookies.

sessionStorage.description: Optional. Captured for completeness; implementations MAY ignore it on injection.

indexedDB.description: Optional. Opaque IndexedDB snapshot in Playwright's storageState format (needed for e.g. Firebase Auth).

browser.description: Fingerprint hints from where the session was captured. Replaying a session with a very different user agent, IP or region can trip bot detection.

platform.description: Node-style platform where captured: darwin, linux, win32.

source.description: login: a human signed in inside a browser the implementation launched. import: copied from another browser or file. capture: snapshotted from a running browser. sync: written back after an agent run.

from.description: Free-form origin detail, e.g. "chrome:Profile 2" or "file:state.json". Never contains secret values.

confirm.description: Require a human confirmation before each launch.

allowExport.description: When false, the raw session may not be exported to a file.
